# Ready for Real

> Ready for Real helps founders review a publicly accessible app or website before real users arrive. It checks observable page and technical signals, then organizes evidence-backed findings into practical next steps. It works with AI-built and traditionally developed products.

The free scan cannot inspect private source code, signed-in areas, or backend configuration. It is not a security certification, accessibility conformance audit, or penetration test. A separate one-time purchase may offer a scan-specific launch plan and coding-agent brief; the live site shows current availability, pricing, and terms.
